caption: The drawing depicts a rural scene featuring a variety of objects and figures composed primarily in muted tan, beige, and green tones with accents of red. In the foreground, two horses, colored brown and black, are pulling a red stagecoach with red wheels and vertical red frame bars; inside the stagecoach are several human figures facing each other. Surrounding the stagecoach are green and yellow shrubs and low plants. To the left, there is a large tree with green foliage and a brown trunk. In the midground, there are two people standing and another horse with two riders; all human figures wear muted clothing in browns and blues. Behind them, a large red house with white window frames and green shutters is partially obscured by two additional green trees. In the background, tan rolling hills occupy the top third of the drawing, where three covered wagons, colored white with brown accents, are visible, each pulled by horses or oxen. The overall color palette is warm and earthy, with red used distinctively on the house and stagecoach. The drawing is outlined in darker lines, and the paper or fabric background is beige.
title: Printed Cotton with Genre Scenes
